en: This is a black and white image of an old postcard. The postcard is labeled 'Postkarte' at the top left, which is German for postcard. It is addressed to 'Herrn Professor K. Pagel' in 'Berlin' on 'Chausseestr.' There is handwriting in German and a visible postal stamp mark in the upper right corner. The edges of the postcard are slightly worn and a corner is missing.
